title: Words after a template's name fill its blanks
body:
A prompt template's blanks are filled in the prompt after `/t <name>` chooses it (`src/template.rs`, `choose_template` in `src/app.rs`). Words typed after the name are not read: `/t typos README.md` matches no template.

## Proposal

- Words after the template's name fill its blanks in the order the blanks appear in its text. `/t typos README.md` fills `{file}` and sends, since no blank is left.
- A blank the words do not reach is left in the prompt to fill as usual.

## Open

- How a value of several words is given: quotes, as in `/t away "fix the bar" "an hour"`, or another separator.
- Whether this still applies once templates open a form (see the template form issue), or only to templates with no form.
